title: Width-three-CNF evaluation criterion
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits and $g$ gates, and let $x$ be an input assignment. The circuit accepts $x$ if and only if there is a choice of signs for its $g$ gate coordinates such that the width-three CNF encoding is satisfied by the combined assignment consisting of the input signs corresponding to $x$ and those gate signs.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit with input dimension n
An input assignment to the circuit
